root_cause: The decision-tree adapter was authored against a draft dictionary/source-inspection interface. The registered dependency returns (DayArrays, SourceRecord), exposes DayArrays attributes, names the feature underreaction, and has no inspect_source or utc_start helper.
deterministic_adapter_changes: Use day, record = base.aggregate(path, symbol, date) and retain both.
Alias the registered underreaction feature to the frozen decision-tree name under.
Attach the registered leader mark array to the event feature dictionary without changing values.
Compute UTC day start directly from the frozen date string instead of a nonexistent helper.
